en: This postcard features a black and white hand-drawn portrait of a serious-looking man in formal attire, signed 'Antonio Carneiro 1909' at the bottom of the portrait. Below the portrait, there is a large cursive signature reading 'A. Herculano'. At the bottom left, there is a quote in Portuguese, and printing details indicating Paris. The bottom right contains a number '4'.
